using namespace std;

typedef long long LL;

LL modpow(LL a, LL b, LL mod) {
    LL res = 1;
    while (b > 0) {
        if (b & 1) res = (res * a) % mod;
        a = (a * a) % mod;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

LL modinv(LL a, LL mod) {
    return modpow(a, mod - 2, mod);
}

LL gcd(LL a, LL b) {
    return b == 0 ? a : gcd(b, a % b);
}

LL lcm(LL a, LL b) {
    return a / gcd(a, b) * b;
}

LL binexp(LL a, LL b, LL mod) {
    LL res = 1;
    while (b > 0) {
        if (b & 1) res = (res * a) % mod;
        a = (a * a) % mod;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

LL binexp(LL a, LL b) {
    return binexp(a, b, 1e9 + 7);
}

void solve() {
    LL n, kb;
    cin >> n >> kb;
    vector<LL> dig;
    while (n > 0) {
        dig.push_back(n % kb);
        n /= kb;
    }
    vector<vector<LL>> A(kb, vector<LL>(kb, 0));
    for (int i = 0; i < kb; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < kb; j++) {
            A[i][j] = binexp(i, j, 1e9 + 7);
        }
    }
    vector<vector<LL>> ans(kb, vector<LL>(kb, 0));
    ans[kb - 1][0] = 1;
    LL x = 0;
    for (auto it = dig.rbegin(); it != dig.rend(); it++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < *it; j++) {
            for (int k = 0; k < kb; k++) {
                ans[k][(x + j) % kb] = (ans[k][(x + j) % kb] + ans[k][j]) % (1e9 + 7);
            }
        }
        x = (x + *it) % kb;
    }
    LL res = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < kb; i++) {
        res = (res + ans[i][0]) % (1e9 + 7);
    }
    cout << res + 1 << endl;
    return;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    int t = 1;
    while (t--) {
        solve();
    }
    return 0;
}
